Detailed Description

Translates images files to scores.

Various image processing algorithms may be applied to the original image before the resulting image is translated to notes. Any number of such operations may be specified, but the order of processing is fixed.

◆ traverse()

void csound::Node::traverse ( const Eigen::MatrixXd & global_coordinates,
Score & global_score )
virtualinherited

The default implementation postconcatenates its own local coordinate system with the global coordinates, then passes the score and the product of coordinate systems to each child, thus performing a depth-first traversal of the music graph.

In case a derived class needs to apply a different local transformation to each child node's notes, this method must be overridden. After child nodes have been traversed, notes generated by the child nodes are passed to the transform method of this, and the resulting notes appended to the gobal score; then an empty score is passed to the generate method of this, and the resulting notes appended to the global score.

Reimplemented in csound::Intercut, csound::Koch, csound::ScoreModel, csound::Sequence, and csound::Stack.

References children, generate(), getLocalCoordinates(), transform(), and csound::Score::transform().

Referenced by csound::ScoreModel::traverse().
